case.pattern_description: The transaction was an online card-not-present purchase made from a new device exhibiting an anonymous proxy flag, matching confirmed historical fraud for this customer.
case.summary: Case HHG-020 started with a high fraud probability of 0.95 due to a card-not-present transaction on a new device, though the device fingerprint itself was too generic to indicate a wider fraud ring. Customer validation confirmed that the cardholder did not make the purchase and still possessed the physical card. Based on this customer denial, the card was blocked at level 1, and the case was officially closed with a confirmed fraud verdict for a $125.08 exposure.
